narrative: 笑点、陷阱，或某种社会系统，其实早已存在于这个人周围。镜头只是承认了这一点。
因为机位没有变化，这次揭示带有一种观察者的意味：我们一直站在这么远的地方，只是选择看到了更多。如果摄影机必须穿过一扇门后退、失去一个前景，或在真实空间中把某人抛下，那么这就不是合适的工具。
光学变宽没办法真正走出一个房间。
how: 锁定三脚架，反向操作变焦。从一个构图完整的紧景画面开始，预先构思好宽景的结束画面，让人头、标牌和负空间各就其位。
随着焦距变短，景深会加深。提示词：三脚架锁定的光学变焦拉远，摄影机机身不移动，并说明最后一帧中必须出现的建筑元素。
when: 用它来揭示语境、孤立感，或一个原本就藏在场景中的画外笑点。具体场景：一张紧凑的脸逐渐展开，露出一直在旁观的整张餐桌。
不要用它来离开一个场景：那属于真实的物理后退。
vs: 拉镜头（Pull Out）和推轨后拉（Dolly Out）让摄影机真正向后移动，因此前景物体会带着视差离开画面。慢速变焦拉远则只是改变镜头的视角范围。
如果同一场戏中还需要用到慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）这个近亲技巧，要保持两者的机身都锁定，让这一对镜头都停留在纯光学的层面上。
examples_film: 《巴里·林登》（Barry Lyndon）在不移动摄影机进入聚会的情况下，拉宽成一幅幅画意的社交群像。《社交网络》（The Social Network）、《她》（Her）和《迷失东京》（Lost in Translation）用缓慢的光学变宽，把一个人放置在一个他无法逃离的系统之中。
要学的是语法，而不是照搬画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是推轨后拉。破绽在于前景产生滑动：植物、肩膀，或门框之间的遮挡关系发生了变化。
解决办法：冻结支撑装置，只改变焦距，然后在宽景上保持不动。

faq.q: 电影中的慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）是什么？
faq.a: 它是在摄影机保持锁定的情况下逐渐减小焦距，使画面变宽，而摄影机的位置保持不变。

faq.q: 慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）与推轨后拉（Dolly Out）的区别
faq.a: 推轨后拉是在空间中真正后退，会产生视差。慢速变焦拉远则始终停留在三脚架上，只是把镜头调宽，因此各层次之间原有的透视关系保持不变。

faq.q: 什么时候该用慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）？
faq.a: 当周围的情境本身就是笑点或牢笼、你想在不移动摄影机的情况下揭示它时使用。不要把它当作离开房间的替代方案。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明锁定的三脚架、光学变焦拉远，以及必须揭示的内容。示例：tripod locked, lens slowly zooming out for 6 seconds, architecture entering, no body travel.

narrative: The joke, the trap, or the social system was already around the person. The lens simply admits it.

Because the station point is unchanged, the reveal feels observational: we were always this far away, we only chose to see more. It is the wrong tool when the camera must retreat through a doorway, lose a foreground, or leave someone behind in real space.
Optical widening cannot walk out of a room.
how: Lock the tripod and reverse the zoom. Start on a composed tight frame and pre-compose the wide end so heads, signs, and negative space land.
Focus will deepen as focal length shortens. Prompt a tripod-locked optical zoom out, no camera body travel, and name what architecture must appear by the last frame.
when: Use it to reveal context, isolation, or an off-screen joke that was already in the location. Concrete beat: a tight face opening onto a dinner table that has been watching.
Do not use it to exit a location: that is a physical pull.
vs: A Pull Out and a Dolly Out move the camera backward, so foreground objects leave the frame with parallax. A slow zoom out only changes the lens angle of view.
If you also need a Slow Zoom In cousin in the same scene, keep both bodies locked so the pair stays optical.
examples_film: Barry Lyndon widens into painterly social tableaux without walking the camera into the party. The Social Network, Her, and Lost in Translation use slow optical opening to place a person inside a system they cannot leave.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Out. The tell is a sliding foreground: plants, shoulders, or door jambs changing their overlap.
The fix is to freeze the support and drive only focal length, then hold the wide.

faq.q: What is Slow Zoom Out in film?
faq.a: It is a gradual decrease of focal length from a locked camera, so the frame widens while the camera's position stays the same.

faq.q: Slow Zoom Out vs Dolly Out
faq.a: Dolly out retreats through space and creates parallax. Slow zoom out stays on the sticks and only widens the lens, so planes keep their original perspective relation.

faq.q: When should I use Slow Zoom Out?
faq.a: When the surrounding situation is the punchline or the prison, and you want to disclose it without relocating the camera. Do not use it as a substitute for leaving the room.

faq.q: How do I prompt Slow Zoom Out for AI image or video?
faq.a: State locked tripod, optical zoom out, and what must be revealed. Example: tripod locked, lens slowly zooming out for 6 seconds, architecture entering, no body travel.
